defect: The new file calls std::optional::value() (in GetRecoveryType and ReconcileTimestampDiscrepancy), which is marked unavailable on macOS SDKs older than 10.14 and breaks the build there.
reason: Both .value() calls the fix replaces with operator* were added by this change, and the fix repairs a real compile failure on an older macOS toolchain.

defect: The new error message uses the PRIx64 macro from <inttypes.h> without defining __STDC_FORMAT_MACROS, so the file does not compile on the Linux server toolchain.
reason: The PRIx64 format line and the include were added by this change, and the same-day fix reverts them to repair the compile failure.

defect: The fix replaces the std::map keyed by Slice with slice_comparator by a vector to repair wrong ordering of prefix sub-indexes in PopulateIndex; this change only made the comparator's operator() const.
reason: The ordering defect lies in the map-based index building that predates this change, which only added const for a Mac compile fix.

defect: The fix only reformats rocksdb_delete_range_cf (clang-format), with no behaviour change.
reason: A pure formatting change is not a defect repair.

defect: The new log line calls cfd->imm()->NumNotFlushed() after mutex_ was released in SwitchMemtable, racing with the background flush thread writing MemTableList::current_.
reason: The unprotected NumNotFlushed() read was added by this change and the fix moves it under the DB mutex to remove the TSAN-reported race.

defect: saved_seq_for_penul_check_ is set for swapped TimedPut entries but only cleared inside DecideOutputLevel's output_to_penultimate_level_ branch, so a stale value can be consumed by a later entry and cause a false Corruption report.
reason: The saved_seq_for_penul_check_ logic and its conditional clearing were added by this change, and the fix clears it unconditionally.

defect: GetWalPreallocateBlockSize calls std::min with mixed types (uint64_t bsize vs size_t db_write_buffer_size and buffer_size()), which fails template deduction on Mac where uint64_t and size_t differ.
reason: The std::min calls were added by this change and break the Mac build; the fix adds explicit template arguments to those same calls.

defect: The fix changes WriteBatch::Data() to return const std::string& instead of a copy, an API/performance refinement.
reason: Returning by value is not a correctness defect and already existed before this change; the fix is an interface improvement.

defect: The fix only rewraps lines and fixes tab indentation in Java_org_rocksdb_Options_setBuiltinComparator for lint.
reason: A lint/style fix is not a defect repair.

defect: CleanupFilesAfterRecovery builds file paths as NormalizePath(path + fname) where the directory paths have no trailing separator, so it computes and deletes wrong paths such as '/db000123.sst'.
reason: The path concatenation was added by this change and the fix appends the separator to each directory before joining.

defect: The fix makes the assert(alive_log_files_tail_ == alive_log_files_.rbegin()) run only when a mutex is held, because the unprotected deque comparison fails on Mac.
reason: The unguarded rbegin assertion already existed before this change; the change only moved the rend assertion under the mutex condition.

defect: The fix changes AllocateKey to take a unique_ptr guard to repair a scan-build memory leak in WriteSeqSeekSeq, touching ReadRandomFast only mechanically.
reason: ReadRandomFast added by this change already guards its key with unique_ptr; the leak is in other code.

defect: The fix renames the test names from 'Paraniod' to 'Paranoid'.
reason: A typo rename in test names is not a defect.

defect: MemTableListVersion::Add takes an extra Ref on the memtable although DBImpl hands over its own reference (and Remove adds a matching Unref), so memtables still in the immutable list leak their extra reference when the version is released.
reason: The Ref in Add and the Unref in Remove were added by this change, and the fix removes both to restore correct reference counting.

defect: The new alignment check binds 'const FSReadRequest& r' that is used only inside assert(), so release builds get an unused-variable warning, which -Werror turns into a build failure.
reason: The variable was added by this change and the fix inlines reqs[i] into the asserts to fix the release-mode build.

defect: delete_filter's new parameter is named argv but its new assert uses 'arg', an undeclared identifier, so db_test fails to compile whenever asserts are enabled (OPT=-g).
reason: Both the renamed parameter and the assert were added by this change, and the fix corrects the identifier to repair the compile error.

defect: PosixFileSystem::AbortIO returns Poll's result, which is NotSupported without io_uring, so the FilePrefetchBuffer destructor's assert(s.ok()) after AbortIO fails although no request is pending.
reason: AbortIO was added by this change and the fix maps NotSupported from Poll to OK.

defect: The fix corrects prefetch_size after data is copied from both buffers (prefetch_size -= length should be length + readahead_size), which made async_io read the wrong length; it also replaces a no-op 'prefetch_size -= length' after 'length = 0' added here, which only over-prefetches.
reason: The wrong-length defect that caused iterator divergence is in the overlap-branch line that predates this change; the line this change added only causes extra prefetching, not wrong results.

defect: The fix makes the flaky UniversalCompactionTrivialMoveTest2 tolerate L0->L0 non-trivial compactions instead of restricting background compactions.
reason: This is a test-only flakiness change and the flaky condition predates this change.

defect: The fix adds a missing 'override' to DisableGCSnapshotChecker::IsInSnapshot for builds with -Wsuggest-override.
reason: The missing override predates this change, which only commented out parameter names, and the fix is a style/warning fix for a non-default flag.

defect: The new test code stores TestGetTickerCount's long result in int variables, which triggers -Wshorten-64-to-32 and breaks the clang build.
reason: The int declarations were added by this change and the same-day 'Fix clang build' changes them to long.

defect: InstallSuperVersion now unrefs old_superversion before ResetThreadLocalSuperVersions, so a thread-local slot can hold the last reference and SuperVersionUnrefHandle locks the DB mutex under the ThreadLocalPtr mutex, which can deadlock with a flush that holds the DB mutex during Scrape.
reason: This change moved ResetThreadLocalSuperVersions after the old superversion Unref, and the fix restores the reset-before-unref order.

defect: remote_compaction_worker_threads is only reserve()d and then written and read through operator[] beyond size(), which is undefined behaviour (and the capacity()==count assert need not hold).
reason: The reserve-plus-index code was added by this change and the fix switches to push_back and size().

defect: The fix removes smallest_output_key_prefix[0] = 0 and largest_output_key_prefix[0] = 0, which became invalid when a later commit changed those fields from char arrays to std::string.
reason: At this change the fields were char[9], so the assignments were correct; the defect came from the later type change (bb808ead).

defect: The fix adapts the test to a new RegisterOptions/GetOptions API and adds PrepareOptions tests for Customizable classes.
reason: The test-file changes are API migration and new tests, not a repair of a defect in this change's mechanical RegisterOptions call updates.

defect: NextFromInput passes the unbounded snap_refresh_cnt_ to TimeToRefresh, which shifts snap_refresh_nanos_ by snap_refresh_cnt*2 bits, so after enough refreshes the shift reaches the width of uint64_t (undefined behaviour reported by UBSAN).
reason: This change added the snapshot-refresh counter and the shift logic, and the fix removes the counter and bounds the shift.

defect: The fix sets base_index_ = index in PickCompactionBySize, renames number_of_files_to_sort_ and reworks a debug consistency check, all in code added by later performance-branch commits.
reason: PickCompactionBySize did not exist at this change, where base_index_ = i in PickCompaction is a correct file index.

defect: LevelIterator stores a null prefix_extractor when total_order_seek is set, so a table reader created during a total-order seek is cached without a prefix extractor and a later prefix seek with a hash index crashes.
reason: The total_order_seek ? nullptr : prefix_extractor initialisation was added by this change and the fix reverts it, checking total_order_seek at the use site instead.

defect: CheckMemtableFull calls imm->NumFlushed() on the write path without the DB mutex, racing with MemTableList::InstallNewVersion.
reason: The NumFlushed() check was added by this change and the fix replaces it with an atomic HasHistory() flag.

defect: The fix makes WalManagerTest use MockEnv with fake sleeping to remove timing flakiness.
reason: This is a test-only flakiness change, not a product defect.

defect: The fix adds fake-sleep time support (env-based Now, GetCurrentTime, NowMicros, FakeSleepForMicroseconds) to MockEnv for deterministic tests.
reason: This is a test-infrastructure feature, unrelated to this change's narrowing casts.

defect: The fix changes env_ to MockEnv* and adds a FakeSleeping test for the new MockEnv feature.
reason: This is a test addition for a new feature, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix makes MultiGetWithCallback pass the transaction read callback to MultiGetImpl so MultiGet in a transaction does not return uncommitted data.
reason: Before this change MultiGetWithCallback already passed nullptr as the callback, so the dropped-callback defect predates it.

defect: The fix updates the DeleteRangeNotSupported test to expect WriteBatch atomicity and WAL recoverability after the product fix.
reason: This change only added a test documenting a pre-existing bug; the fix repairs product code elsewhere and updates the test.

defect: The fix renames Compaction getters (IsDeletionCompaction to deletion_compaction, GetOutputPathId to output_path_id) to follow Google style.
reason: A naming refactor is not a defect repair.

defect: When the table is over its occupancy limit, Insert allocates a detached ClockHandle even if the caller passed handle == nullptr, so the pointer is never stored or released and the handle leaks.
reason: The detached-handle allocation path was added by this change and the fix allocates it only when handle != nullptr (and also handles a full table).

defect: getMergedHistogram holds merge_lock while ThreadLocalPtr::Fold takes the thread-local meta mutex, while a dying thread's exit handler takes the meta mutex and then merge_lock, giving a lock-order inversion deadlock.
reason: getMergedHistogram and its locking were added by this change and the fix releases merge_lock before folding.

defect: prefix_start_ is a Slice pointing into the caller's seek target or into saved_key_'s buffer, which is later overwritten or freed, so prefix comparisons read dangling or changed memory.
reason: The Slice member and its assignments were added by this change and the same-day fix stores the prefix in an owning IterKey.

defect: LogBuffer::AddLogToBuffer is declared variadic, so LogToBuffer cannot forward its va_list and calls AddLogToBuffer(format) with no arguments, making vsnprintf read nonexistent varargs (Valgrind error).
reason: The LogBuffer interface and its forwarding were added by this change and the fix changes AddLogToBuffer to take a va_list.

defect: The fix adapts the test to Options::prefix_extractor having become a shared_ptr (reset instead of raw assignment and delete).
reason: At this change prefix_extractor was a raw const pointer, so the code was correct; the breakage came from a later API change.
